title: Tokyo-Style Hot Pot with Sesame Falafel
description: A Japanese-inspired twist on the classic hot pot, served with crispy sesame-crusted falafel and a side of creamy hummus.
instructions: Prepare a Japanese-style hot pot with water and a dash of soy sauce.
Meanwhile, mix sesame seeds and sesame oil in a bowl.
Coat the falafel with the sesame seed mixture.
Heat a non-stick pan and cook the falafel until crispy.
Serve the falafel with a side of creamy hummus and chopped scallions.
Place the hot pot in the center of the table and let everyone cook their favorite ingredients.
Serve with a variety of dipping sauces, such as soy sauce or wasabi.
Cook the falafel for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
Serve the hot pot with steaming hot water and a side of sesame-crusted falafel.
Add a dash of soy sauce and chopped scallions to the hot pot for added flavor.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
